advanced-filter-description: Isihlungi esithuthukileyo sivumela ukubhala umbhalo olalezi zisebenzisi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Isikhala sisetshenziswa ukwehlukanisa izisebenzisi. Ungahlunga zonke izinkambu ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ngokubhala amabizo lamanani azo. Isibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Qaphela: Nxa izinkambu loba amanani elezikhala, kumele uwafake phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezilodwa. Isibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ukweqa izimpawu zokulawula ezilodwa (' /), ungasebenzisa \. Isibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa futhi izimo ezinengi. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokujwayelekileyo zonke izisebenzisi zihunyutshwa kusukela kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla. Ungatshintsha ukuhlelwa ngokufaka izibaya. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungasesha futhi izinkambu zombhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Kuyahambelana nxa ikhadi lisungulwa, kumbe isihloko loba incazelo yalo iguqulwa, njalo umbhalo omutsha ulalokhu (akulani mahluko phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezinkulu lezincane).
imported-member-no-account: Ilunga elingenisiweyo — akula akhawunti efanelanayo okwamanje
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe ku-Kanboard: into elama-"columns" (loba imisebenzi ele-column_name) kanye lohlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Amakholomu aba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Namathisela i-JSON yebhodi le-NextCloud Deck (ibhodi elama-"stacks", isitaki ngasinye silama-"cards"). Izitaki ziba yizinhlu, amakhadi abe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namathisela i-JSON yeqoqo lemisebenzi ye-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Izimo ziba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namathisela uhlu lwe-JSON lwezinkinga ze-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Izinkinga ziba ngamakhadi ahlelwe kuzinhlu Ezivuliweyo / Ezivaliweyo.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe emisebenzini ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } evela ekukhitshweni kwe-Asana loba GET /tasks). Imisebenzi ihlelwa ngezigaba (memberships); eqediweyo iya ku-Qediwe.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe kuluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Izigaba ziba yizinhlu, izinto zibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela uhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela ezisetshenziswa amathulusi e-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): izihloko ze "## Ibizo lohlu", nezinto ze "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngaphansi. Izihloko ziba luhlu bese izinto ziba amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayela le-.leo). Izingxenye ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu, izingxenye ezingaphansi kwazo ngokuqondileyo ziba ngamakhadi, umbhalo wengxenye ube yincazelo yekhadi. Izingxenye ezisemazingeni ajulileyo ziba yizinhlu zokuhlola. Izingxenye eziphawuliweyo zingeniswa njengeziqediweyo.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namathisela uhlaka lwe-OPML, njengalokhu iWorkflowy, iDynalist, iOmniOutliner, iLogseq lezinye izinhlelo zohlaka ziluthumela. Izinto zezinga eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu, abantwana bazo baba ngamakhadi lenothi njengencazelo, lezinto ezijulileyo ziba yizinhlu zokuhlola. Izinto eziqediweyo zingeniswa ziqediwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namathisela ifayili ye-Org mode, njengalokhu iEmacs, iOrgzly loba iBeorg iyibhala. Izihloko zezinga eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu lezihloko zezinga lesibili ziba ngamakhadi. I-TODO le-DONE, okuqakathekileyo, amathegi, i-SCHEDULED, i-DEADLINE le-CLOSED kuyagcinwa, lamabhokisi okukhetha lezihloko ezijulileyo kuba yizinhlu zokuhlola.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namathisela ifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenzi owodwa emzileni ngamunye, ngendlela uhlelo lwe-todo.txt lezinhlelo ezihambelanayo ezibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi ephelileyo ("x") iya kweseziphelile, +project lo-@context kuba ngamalebula, (A) iba yilebula yokuqakatheka, kuthi due: lo-t: kube zinsuku zokucina lezokuqala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namathisela umphumela we-task export: uluhlu lwe-JSON kumbe umsebenzi owodwa emgqeni ngamunye. Imisebenzi ephelileyo iya ku-Done, project le-priority kuba ngamalebula, annotations iba yimibono, kuthi depends ibe yikuncika emisebenzini evimbayo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha ifayela le-.boardarchive endaweni ecindezelweyo ubusukunamathisela okuse-board.jsonl yebhodi, lomugqa wenguqulo kumbe ngaphandle kwawo. Uphawu lokuqoqela emaqenjini ekubonweni kwebhodi luba yizinhlu, ezinye impawu zokukhetha ziba ngamalebula, izingxenye zombhalo lamabhokisi okumaka ziba yincazelo loluhlu lokuhlola, njalo imibono iyagcinwa. Imifanekiso lokunamathiselweyo akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: KuMeisterTask, chofoza ibizo lephrojekthi, khetha Export project uthumele i-CSV, ubusuyinamathisela. Izigaba ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamanothi ayo, ilanga lokucina, onikwe umsebenzi lamathegi; imisebenzi eqediweyo igcina ilanga layo lokuqediwa. I-CSV ebhalelwe ukungenisa kukaMeisterTask uqobo layo layo iyasebenza.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: KuObsidian, vula ifayili yebhodi yeKanban njenge-Markdown (loba uvule ifayili ye-.md kusihleli sombhalo), ubusunamathisela yonke. Imizila iba yizinhlu lemikhawulo yamakhadi azo, amakhadi agcina amathegi awo, amalanga, okuqakathekileyo, izikhala lohlu lokuhlola, njalo i-Archive iba ngamakhadi asengobweni yomlando.
import-board-instruction-linear: KuLinear, thumela izindaba njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, loba ukuthumela kombono), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, amaqembu aba yimizila, lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi lonikwe umsebenzi, amalebula, amalanga, indaba engumzali, okuqakathekileyo, isilinganiso, iphrojekthi lomjikelezo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: KuTickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import wenze isipele, ubusunamathisela ifayili ye-CSV. Uluhlu ngalunye lweTickTick luba ngumzila lamakholamu alo aba yizinhlu; imisebenzi igcina amathegi ayo, amalanga, uluhlu lokuhlola, okuqakathekileyo lemisebenzi emincane.
import-board-instruction-clickup: KuClickUp, thumela imisebenzi njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, loba ukuthumela kombono we-List loba we-Table lawo wonke amakholamu), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, izinhlu zeClickUp ziba yimizila, lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi lemisebenzi yawo emincane, abanikwe umsebenzi, amathegi, amalanga, okuqakathekileyo lesikhathi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: KuNullboard, vula ibhodi, khetha Export this board... kumenyu, vula ifayili ye-.nbx kusihleli sombhalo unamathisele okuphakathi kwayo. Izinhlu ziba yizinhlu lamanothi aba ngamakhadi: umugqa wokuqala wenothi yisihloko sekhadi lokunye kuyincazelo yalo. Inothi engaphekwanga ithola ilebula ethi raw. Ifayili elamabhodi amanengi ingenisa ibhodi yayo yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-kanri: KuKanri, vula Import & Export ukhethe Export individual board (loba Export all data), ubusunamathisela ifayili ye-.json. Amakholamu aba yizinhlu lamakhadi aba ngamakhadi, lencazelo yawo, ilanga lokucina, amathegi lemibala; imisebenzi yekhadi iba luhlu lokuhlola. Ekuthumeleni yonke idatha kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-planka: Bhala ikheli le-Planka yakho (ngokwesibonelo https://planka.example.com), ibizo lomsebenzisi kanye lephasiwedi ye-Planka, ubusucinda «Khombisa okungangeniswa». Kusetshenziswa kuphela ukulanda ibhodi njalo akugcinwa. Khetha ibhodi ucinde «Landa»: i-WeKan iyalibala ku-API ye-Planka kanye loluhlu lwalo, amakhadi, izichasiso, insuku zokuphela, amalebula, amalunga, uluhlu lwemisebenzi lemibono, ubusuqhubeka lokungenisa njengokwejwayelekileyo. Amakhadi asesiphaleni se-Planka angeniswa egciniwe; okunamathiselweyo lamakhadi asemgqomeni wenkunkuma kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ku-Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), ngena, uvume imvumo ye-Tasks.Read ukopishe i-token kuthebhu ye-Access token. Yinamathisele lapha ucinde «Khombisa okungangeniswa»; i-token isetshenziswa kulokhu kulanda kuphela njalo ayigcinwa. Khetha uluhlu lonke kumbe olulodwa ucinde «Landa». Uluhlu ngalunye lwe-To Do luba luluhlu lomsebenzi ngamunye ube likhadi, kanye lamanothi, insuku zokuphela lezokuqala, izinyathelo njengoluhlu lokuhlola, izigaba njengamalebula, ukuqakatheka okuphezulu lesimo njengamalebula; imisebenzi eqedileyo iyagcinwa. Izikhumbuzo lokuphindaphinda kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ku-KanbanFlow, vula imenyu yebhodi, ukhethe Settings → API & Webhooks ukopishe i-API token yebhodi. Namathisela i-token lapha, ucinde «Khombisa okungangeniswa», ukhethe ibhodi ucinde «Landa»; i-token isetshenziswa kulokho kulanda kuphela njalo ayigcinwa. Amakholamu aba luluhlu lemizila ihlala iyimizila; imisebenzi igcina isichasiso, umbala, amalebula, usuku lokuphela, imisetshenzana njengoluhlu lokuhlola, isikhathi esisetshenzisiweyo, isilinganiso, abantu lemibono.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Bhala i-ID ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Basecamp (inombolo elandela basecamp.com/ ekhelini) le-token yokungena (evela ku-app ye-OAuth 2 ebhaliswe ku-launchpad.37signals.com, kumbe esiyikhona ekuhlanganiseni okukhona), ucinde «Khombisa okungangeniswa», ukhethe iphrojekthi ucinde «Landa». I-token isetshenziswa kulokho kulanda kuphela njalo ayigcinwa. Ithebula ngalinye lamakhadi liba ngumzila olamakholamu alo njengoluhlu, loluhlu lokumele kwenziwe luba ngumzila «To-dos»; amakhadi lokumele kwenziwe kugcina umbhalo, insuku, abanikwe umsebenzi lemibono, izinyathelo zekhadi ziba luluhlu lokuhlola, lokuqedileyo kuyagcinwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Thola i-token yokungena ku-OAuth 2.0 Playground: ngaphansi kwe-Tasks API v1 khetha tasks.readonly, ucinde Authorize APIs, ubusu Exchange authorization code for tokens, ukopishe i-token yokungena. Yinamathisele lapha ucinde «Khombisa okungangeniswa», ukhethe uluhlu lwemisebenzi lonke kumbe olulodwa, ubusu «Landa». I-token isetshenziswa kulokhu kulanda kuphela njalo ayigcinwa. Uluhlu lwemisebenzi luba luluhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kanye lamanothi, izixhumanisi losuku lokuphela; imisetshenzana iba luluhlu lokuhlola lemisebenzi eqedileyo ingeniswa igciniwe.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: I-API ye-Google Keep ingeyama-akhawunti e-Google Workspace kuphela. Thola i-token yokungena ye-OAuth 2.0 elobubanzi https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ku-OAuth 2.0 Playground uba umphathi we-Workspace yakho ekuvumela, kumbe ku-akhawunti yensizakalo elegunya kuyo yonke idomeyini), yinamathisele, ucinde «Khombisa okungangeniswa» ubusu «Landa». I-token isetshenziswa kulokhu kulanda kuphela njalo ayigcinwa. Amanothi ombhalo aba ngamakhadi ohlwini «Notes», lamanothi oluhlu lokuhlola aba ngamakhadi ohlwini «Lists» lezinto zawo njengoluhlu lokuhlola. Amanothi asemgqomeni, okunamathiselweyo lokwabelana kakungeniswa.
api-import-desc: Kulande kunsizakalo nge-akhawunti yakho. Okubhala lapha kusetshenziswa kulokhu kulanda kuphela njalo akugcinwa.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: KuPivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ethi MORE yephrojekthi ukhethe Export CSV (loba ukhethe izindaba ukhethe Bulk Actions, CSV), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Isimo ngasinye sendaba siba luhlu lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi, lohlobo lwazo lamalebula, abanikazi, ocelayo, amalanga, amazwana, imisebenzi lokuvimbayo; i-Estimate iba ngamaphuzu endaba lemijikelezo iba ngama-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: KuTasks.org, vula Settings, Backups ukhethe Export tasks, ubusunamathisela okuphakathi kwefayili leyo ye-.json. Izinhlu ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamanothi ayo, amathegi, amalanga, amazwana lemisebenzi emincane; imisebenzi eqediweyo igcina ilanga layo lokuqediwa, lokuqakathekileyo kuba yisikhala sakho.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ku-monday.com, vula imenyu yebhodi, khetha More actions lo-Export board to Excel (lezibuyekezo lezinto ezincane nxa uthanda), ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Ikholamu ye-Status iba yizinhlu lamaqembu aba yimizila; abantu, amalanga, umugqa wesikhathi lamathegi kugcina izindawo zakho, amanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho lezibuyekezo ziba ngamazwana.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: KuSuper Productivity, vula Settings, ubusuvula Sync & Backup, khetha Export Data unamathisele okuphakathi kwefayili ye-sp-backup .json. Iphrojekthi ngayinye iba ngumzila lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi ku-To Do, In Progress, Backlog loba Done, lamanothi ayo, amathegi, ilanga lokucina, isikhathi esisetshenzisiweyo lemisebenzi emincane; imisebenzi esengobweni yomlando iba ngamakhadi asengobweni yomlando.
import-board-instruction-taiga: KuTaiga, vula Admin > Project > Export ulande ukuthululwa kwephrojekthi (vula ifayili ye-.json.gz kuqala), ubusunamathisela i-JSON yayo. Izimo zezindaba zabasebenzisi ziba yizinhlu, izindaba zabasebenzisi ziba ngamakhadi lemisebenzi yazo njengemisebenzi emincane, ama-epic lezindaba athola imizila yawo, njalo ama-sprint, amathegi, amazwana lezimpawu zakho kuza lakho. Okunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: KuVikunja, vula Settings, khetha Data Export ulande ifayili ye-.zip ekuthumelela yona, ubusukhetha leyo fayili, loba unamathisele i-data.json ephakathi kwayo. Amabhakede eKanban aba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamalebula awo, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga, incazelo, izinhlu zemisebenzi njengezinhlu zokuhlola lamazwana; okuqakathekileyo, iphesenti eliqediweyo lokuqediweyo kuba yizikhala zakho. Okunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-quire: KuQuire, vula imenyu yephrojekthi ukhethe Export CSV, ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lemisebenzi yawo emincane njengamakhadi angabantwana, abanikwe umsebenzi, amathegi njengamalebula, amalanga okuqala, okucina lokuqediwa, incazelo lokuqakathekileyo njengesikhala sakho. Amazwana lokunamathiselweyo kakukho ku-CSV kaQuire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: KuWrike, thumela iphrojekthi loba ifolda ku-Excel, loba ugcwalise ithempulethi ye-Excel yokungenisa kaWrike, ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Imigqa yefolda leyephrojekthi iba yimizila, i-Status iba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, le-Key yawo, umsebenzi ongumzali, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga okuqala lokucina, okuncikileyo lencazelo; i-Priority, i-Duration lamanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: KuTeamwork.com, gcwalisa ithempulethi ye-Excel yokungenisa imisebenzi (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) uyilondoloze njenge-.xlsx, ubusukhetha leyo fayili. Izinhlu zemisebenzi ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi; umsebenzi oqala ngo -, # loba > uba ngumsebenzi omncane womsebenzi ongaphezu kwawo (--, ## loba >> izinga elilodwa ngaphansi). Abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga lamathegi kugcina izindawo zakho; i-Priority, i-Estimated time le-Complete kuba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: KuBusinessmap (owayesakuthiwa yiKanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetha Configure results ukuze ukhethe amakholamu, ulande ifayili ye-Excel, ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Amakholamu afundwa ngamabizo awo esiNgisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): nxa i-akhawunti yakho isebenzisa olunye ulimi, qamba kabutsha umugqa wezihloko ngesiNgisi kuqala. I-Column iba yizinhlu le-Lane iba yimizila; abanikazi, amathegi, umbala, amalanga, amazwana lamalinki abazali kugcina izindawo zakho, njalo i-Priority, i-Size, i-Type lamanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-redmine: KuRedmine, vula ama-Issues ephrojekthi, khetha Also available in: CSV phansi kohlu, khetha amakholamu (All columns, le-Description) uthumele, ubusunamathisela i-CSV. URedmine uqamba amakholamu ngolimi lwakho, ngakho beka ulimi lwakho lube yisiNgisi ku-My account ungakathumeli. Isimo ngasinye siba luhlu lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi, le-tracker njengelebula, onikwe umsebenzi, umbhali, amalanga, umsebenzi ongumzali lezindaba ezihambelanayo; okuqakathekileyo, isigaba, inguqulo eqondiweyo, isikhathi esilinganiselweyo, i-% Done lezikhala zakho kuba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-notion: KuNotion, vula idathabheyisi njengekhasi eligcweleyo, khetha ••• lo-Export, khetha Markdown & CSV, ukhethe ifayili ye-.zip eyilandayo, loba i-CSV eyodwa yedathabheyisi kuyo, loba unamathisele leyo CSV. Ikholamu ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Status iba yizinhlu (nxa ingekho, ikholamu yokuqala ekhangeleka njengokukhetha iba yizo, njalo umbiko wokungenisa uyatsho ukuthi yiyiphi); imigqa iba ngamakhadi lesihloko sawo, amathegi njengamalebula, abantu njengamalunga, amalanga, lombhalo wekhasi njengencazelo; amanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho. Ubudlelwano, imifanekiso lokunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-plane: KuPlane, vula Workspace Settings, khetha Exports, thumela amaphrojekthi njenge-JSON, CSV loba Excel ulande ifayili ye-.zip, ubusukhetha leyo fayili, loba ifayili eyodwa ephakathi kwayo, loba unamathisele i-JSON loba i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, amaphrojekthi aba yimizila, lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi lophawu lwazo, umzali, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalebula, amalanga, amalinki lamazwana; okuqakathekileyo, isilinganiso, umjikelezo lemojuli kuba yizikhala zakho. Ukuthumela kukaPlane kakulazincazelo loba okunamathiselweyo, ngakho kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ebhodini lakho le-Trello, yana ku-'Menu', bese ku-'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ukophele umbhalo ophumayo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namathisela amanani ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma (CSV) / amanani ahlukaniswe ngamathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Namathisela i-JSON evela ekusesheni izinkinga kwe-Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), loba into efanayo { "issues": [...] }. Izimo ze-Jira ziba yizinhlu, izinkinga zibe ngamakhadi. Ungafaka ngokuzikhethela uhlu lwe-"automationRules" ukungenisa imithetho.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha ithebula le-.xlsx ngendlela ye-WeKan (amakholomu afanayo lokukhitshwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugqa wokuqala uyisihloko.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ebhodini lakho, yana ku-'Menu', bese ku-'Export board', ukophele umbhalo osefayeleni elilandiweyo.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Nxa uthola amaphutha ngesikhathi ungenisa ibhodi, kwesinye isikhathi ukungenisa kuyasebenza futhi ibhodi litholakala ekhasini lawo wonke amabhodi.
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengabasebenzisi abamelayo ngamabizo abo, ukuze bahlanganiswe labasebenzisi beqiniso ngemva
csv-mapping-description: Khetha ikholamu yefayili ephethe isikhala ngasinye sekhadi. Ukukhetha kwenziwe ngamabizo amakholamu; tshintsha loba yisiphi esingalunganga, ukhethe (kakukho efayilini) kusikhala esingekho efayilini.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Ifayili kayilakholamu yohlu. Khetha eyodwa ngaphezulu, loba ubhale ibizo lohlu olulodwa lapho wonke amakhadi aya khona.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Amanye amakholamu okungeniswa njengezikhala zakho zombhalo:
csv-mapping-list-required: Bhala ibizo lohlu lapho wonke amakhadi aya khona, loba ukhethe ikholamu ephethe uluhlu.
import-many-boards-hint: Khetha amafayili amanengi okuthumela ale thuluzi, loba i-.zip eyodwa ewaphetheyo: ifayili ngayinye iba yibhodi yayo, ingeniswa ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa amalunga. I-.zip eyiyo uqobo ukuthumela okukodwa (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, loba WeKan lokunamathiselweyo) yibhodi elilodwa. Nxa amafayili ekhethwa lapha, u-Ngenisa uwangenisa esikhundleni sesikhala esingaphezulu.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila ngamunye ongenziwa yikungenisa (iphrojekthi, ifolda loba uluhlu lwethuluzi) uba yibhodi yawo. Amakhadi angabazali lokuncikileyo phakathi kwalawo mabhodi kubhalwe embikweni wokungenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Wonke amabhodi ongawathumela, ekulandeni okukodwa: i-Excel njengebhuku elilodwa lomsebenzi elineshidi ngebhodi ngalinye eliqanjwe ngalo, zonke ezinye izinhlobo njenge-.zip elefayili ngebhodi ngalinye.
import-json-placeholder: Namathisela idatha yakho ye-JSON esebenzayo lapha
import-csv-placeholder: Namathisela idatha yakho ye-CSV/TSV esebenzayo lapha
import-attachments-zip: I-ZIP yokunamathiselweyo kwe-Trello (ngokuzikhethela, evela ku-Trello Card Attachments Downloader)

r-wrike-workflow-note: Indlela yomsebenzi kaWrike luhlu lwezimo, ngasinye siseqenjini elithi Active, Completed, Deferred loba Cancelled. Ukuthumela kubhala izinhlu zale bhodi njengendlela eyodwa, eqanjwe ngebhodi, ku-JSON leyo i-API kaWrike eyibuyisela izindlela zomsebenzi: dala leyo ndlela yomsebenzi kuWrike ungakangenisi ukuthumela kwe-Excel kaWrike kwebhodi, ukuze izimo zayo zisetshenziswe. Ukungenisa kufunda leyo JSON enamathiselwe ngaphezulu, evela kuWeKan loba ku-GET /workflows kaWrike, kubhodi elikhethiweyo: isimo esingelaluhlu siba luhlu, njalo umthetho uphawula ikhadi liqediwe nxa lihanjiswa esimeni se-Completed loba se-Cancelled, lingaqediwanga esimeni se-Active loba se-Deferred. Imithetho kaWrike yokuzenzakalela ingeke ithunyelwe isuka kuWrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ukusesha kungafaka izisebenzisi ukuze kucoliswe ukusesha. Izisebenzisi zichazwa ngokubhala ibizo lesisebenzisi lenani kuhlukaniswe yikholoni. Isibonelo, incazelo yesisebenzisi ethi `list:Blocked` inganciphisa ukusesha kube ngamakhadi asohlwini olubizwa *Blocked*. Nxa inani lilezikhala loba izimpawu ezikhethekileyo kumele lifakwe phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna (isib. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakhadi asebhodini elabelwe inhlangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakhadi asebhodini elabelwe iqembu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakhadi aphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-*<n>* kusukela khathesi. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ibala wonke amakhadi osuku lokuphela oseludlulile.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakhadi adalwe ezinsukwini ezingu-*<n>* ezidluleyo loba ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakhadi alungiswe ezinsukwini ezingu-*<n>* ezidluleyo loba ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - wonke amakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando langekho kuyo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - lapho *<field>* kungokunye kwe-`__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` loba `__predicate_member__`. Ukufaka `-` phambi kwe-*<field>* kusesha ukungabi khona kwenani kuleyo nkambu (isib. `has:-due` kusesha amakhadi angelalanga lokuphela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - lapho *<sort-name>* kungokunye kwe-`__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` loba `__predicate_modified__`. Ukuze uhlele ngokwehlayo, faka `-` phambi kwebizo lokuhlela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - lapho *<n>* kuyinombolo epheleleyo engaphezu kukaziro echaza inani lamakhadi azaboniswa ekhasini ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Izisebenzisi ezifanayo zihlanganiswa ngo-*OR*. Amakhadi amadanisa loba yisiphi isimo ayabuyiselwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ingabuyisela amakhadi akuloba yiluphi uluhlu olubizwa *Blocked* loba *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Izisebenzisi ezitshiyeneyo zihlanganiswa ngo-*AND*. Kubuyiselwa kuphela amakhadi amadanisa zonke izisebenzisi ezitshiyeneyo. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ibuyisela kuphela amakhadi asohlwini *Available* alelebula *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Izinsuku zingachazwa ngenombolo epheleleyo engaphezu loba ngaphansi kukaziro, loba kusetshenziswe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` loba `__predicate_year__` ngesikhathi samanje.

Nxa kuqediwe, khomba i-MONGO_URL kwesinye isizindalwazi ubusuqalisa kutsha i-WeKan (ku-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb loba =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Kopishela wonke amaqoqo asekelwe embhalweni ku-__db__? Okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kusistimu yamafayela akuthinteki. Isizindalwazi okuhanjiswa kuso kumele sisebenze.
sandstorm-migration-description: Nxa i-WeKan isebenza phakathi kwe-grain ye-Sandstorm, isizindalwazi sayo esidala se-MongoDB 3 sithuthelwa ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ekuqalisweni kokuqala, njalo okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kuhanjiswa kusuka kusizindalwazi kuya kuzikhombandlela ze-grain files/attachments le-files/avatars. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi lokho kuthutha kuphumelele yini lokuthi amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB esidala angalungiswanga asasebenzisa indawo engakanani kudiski phakathi kwe-grain, njalo kukuvumela ukuthi ususe lawo mafayela ukuze ukhulule indawo.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ngemva kokuthutha okuphumeleleyo idatha ihlala ku-FerretDB lakusistimu yamafayela, ngakho amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB 3 esidala angalungiswanga angasuswa ukuze kukhululwe indawo kudiski ye-grain. Lokhu akubuyiseki.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB 3 angalungiswanga ukuze kukhululwe indawo kudiski? Idatha isithuthelwe ku-FerretDB lakusistimu yamafayela. Lokhu akubuyiseki.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB angalungiswanga asusiwe, kukhululwe
features-desc: Izici ongazikhethela zona ezinikezwa yi-WeKan. Isici esingakhethwanga siyafihlwa kubo bonke abasebenzisi. Idatha yaso iyagcinwa njalo imvumo ayiguquki.
feature-views-overview-desc: Izibalo, ukuhlanganisa ngokomuntu ophiwe umsebenzi, icebo lomsebenzi, ideshibhodi lebhodi elikhulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Umsebenzi womkhiqizo osalindileyo, izikhathi zomsebenzi ezimfitshane, umbiko waleso sikhathi lesivinini somsebenzi.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Umsebenzi oseleyo, umsebenzi ophelileyo, ukugeleza okuqoqiweyo, isikhathi sokwenza lesokulinda, inani lomsebenzi ophelileyo, isikhathi umsebenzi osulindile, izivimbelo, i-Monte Carlo lezinye izilinganiso zokugeleza komsebenzi.
feature-approval-required: Gcina izici ezifakwe yikubuyekezwa kwe-WeKan zingasebenzi kuze kube umlawuli uyazivula
feature-preview-admins: Abalawuli babona izici ezingasebenzi ukuze bazihlole kuqala
card-field-visibility-desc: Izikhala ze-Board Settings / Card amabhodi angazitshengisa. Isikhala esingakhethwanga sifihlwa kuwo wonke amakhadi, amakhadi amancane lo-Board Settings / Card wamabhodi wonke. Kakulamininingwane yekhadi loba isilungiselelo sebhodi esitshintshayo, njalo ukusikhetha futhi kutshengisa ibhodi ngalinye njengalokhu belibekiwe. Ukulandelana kwezikhala kungokwebhodi ngalinye.
cards-loading-description: I-WeKan ilayisha amakhadi ebhodi ngokuzenzakalela: ibhodi elikhulu (elingaphezu komkhawulo wobukhulu) lilayisha kuphela amakhadi abonakala khathesi (ukuskrola okungapheliyo) lenani elibukhoma, ukuze lihlale lishesha njalo lisebenzise imemori lomkhawulokudlulisa omncane, kuthi amabhodi amancane alayishe wonke amakhadi ukuze asebenze ngendlela elula epheleleyo. Akulalutho olungahlelwa. Abasebenzisi bangaphoqelela imodi nge-CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) le-CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ukulayishwa kwamakhadi ngobuvila kusahlolwa: amanani amakhadi lemikhawulo ye-WIP kuqondile, kodwa ukubukwa kweKhalenda/Ithebula/Gantt lokukhetha okunengi kubonisa kuphela amakhadi alayishiweyo kuze kube khathesi. Layisha kutsha amabhodi avuliweyo ngemva kokutshintsha lokhu.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izixhumanisi (kokubili izixhumanisi ze-markdown ezifana le-[label](url) lamathegi e-HTML <a href>) zihlala ziboniswa njengombhalo ongelalutho ongachofozekiyo kuyo yonke inkambu yombhalo ocebileyo (izihloko zamabhodi lamakhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuvimbela izixhumanisi ezichofozekayo ezidukisayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngakho izixhumanisi zihlala zichofozeka.
always-show-code-as-text: Hlala ubonisa yonke ikhodi njengombhalo ongelalutho
always-show-code-as-text-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, umbhalo ocebileyo awuboniswa njenge-markdown loba i-HTML: wonke umthombo uhlala uboniswa njengombhalo ongelalutho kuyo yonke inkambu yombhalo ocebileyo (izihloko zamabhodi lamakhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuveza okumunyethwe okufihliweyo — amazwana e-HTML (<!-- -->), lapho izixhumanisi ze-markdown ezikhomba khona, i-JavaScript layo yonke enye ikhodi — ukuze yonke ikhodi ihlale ibonakala, ingachofozeki njalo ingasebenzi. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngakho i-markdown iboniswa ngendlela ejwayelekileyo.
disable-all-import-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izici zokungenisa ziyavalwa: ukungenisa ibhodi kusuka ku-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le-Forgejo, kanye lokuphinda ibhodi. Izinketho zemenyu yokungenisa ziyafihlwa njalo iseva iyala zonke izicelo zokungenisa. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-all-export-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izici zokukhupha ziyavalwa: ukukhupha ibhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, loba ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kanye lokukhupha okunamathiselweyo okukodwa. Izinketho zemenyu yokukhupha ziyafihlwa njalo iseva iyala zonke izicelo zokukhupha. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, izithombe zabasebenzisi azingeniswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungenisa kwe-WeKan JSON, ukungenisa kwe-Trello lokuvumelanisa izithombe kusuka kubahlinzeki bobunikazi bangaphandle ngesikhathi sokungena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amabizo lenye idatha kusaqhubeka kungeniswa; kweqiwa izithombe zabasebenzisi kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, izithombe zabasebenzisi azifakwa ekukhutshweni kwebhodi (ukukhupha kwe-WeKan JSON le-CSV). Amabizo abasebenzisi lenye idatha kusaqhubeka kukhutshwa; kweqiwa izithombe zabasebenzisi kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukungenisa ibhodi le-WeKan JSON kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe yikhadi lamazwana angeniswayo. Akulabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi obuvela ebhodini lomthombo obugcinwayo. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu ongenisayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe ngamakhadi lamazwana. Ifayela elikhutshiweyo alilabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe ngamakhadi lamazwana. Ifayela elikhutshiweyo alilabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-activities-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, okufakwayo kokuphakelwa kwemisebenzi akurekhodwa njalo akuboniswa ndawo (kubha eseceleni yebhodi lethebhu yemisebenzi yekhadi). Akulamlando wokuthi ngubani owenze ini ogcinwayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-notifications-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, i-WeKan ayithumeli izaziso zokubukela (ngaphakathi kohlelo, nge-imeyili loba ezinye izisevisi) zanoma yiwuphi umsebenzi. Imisebenzi ingaqhubeka irekhodwa (ngaphandle nxa layo ivaliwe ngenhla); kuvinjelwa izaziso kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-watch-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, isici sokubukela siyavalwa — abasebenzisi abakwazi ukubhalisela amabhodi, izinhlu loba amakhadi ukuze bathole izaziso, njalo yonke imizamo yokutshintsha izinga lokubukela iyaliwa. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
backup-description: Yenza isipele Sokunamathiselweyo, Izithombe zabasebenzisi kanye/loba Idatha (wonke amaqoqo asekelwe embhalweni angasikho okunamathiselweyo loba izithombe zabasebenzisi). I-.zip ithunyelwa ngqo endaweni yokugcina ekhethiweyo — akulafayela lesikhatshana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, imumethe YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le-/data. Izindawo zokugcina zamafu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zisebenzisa imininingwane yokuqinisekisa ehlelwe kumathebhu azo okugcina.
backup-scope-description: Isenzakalo sonke, loba Inhlangano eyodwa. Isipele seNhlangano simumethe amabhodi ayo lakho konke okukuwo, kuhlanganise lokunamathiselweyo kwalawo mabhodi — kodwa kungabi lama-akhawunti abasebenzisi lezilungiselelo zesenzakalo, ngoba lokhu kwabelwana yizo zonke Izinhlangano. Ukubuyisela isipele seNhlangano kubhala kuphela kumabhodi aphethwe yileyo Nhlangano.
continuous-backup-description: Sithumela lonke untshintsho kusizindalwazi, kokunamathiselweyo, ezithombeni zabasebenzisi lakumarekhodi kufolda ngemizuzwana emilutshwana, ukuze kubuyiselwe kunoma yisiphi isikhathi. Sisebenza lesipele esihleliweyo, esakha izinqolobane ezipheleleyo.
continuous-backup-target: Ifolda okuzagcinwa kuyo (indlela epheleleyo, kwenye idiski, endaweni eyabelwana ngayo kunethiwekhi loba endaweni exhunywe nge-rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Amakhasi e-SQLite (amakhasi antshintshileyo ngesikhathi ngasinye esimisiweyo)
continuous-backup-base-every: Isisekelo esitsha njalo ngemva kwamahora amisiweyo
continuous-backup-key-file: Ifayela yesikhiye sokufihla ngekhodi (indlela epheleleyo ngaphandle kwefolda okuzagcinwa kuyo; inhlamvu ezingu-64 zohlelo lwenombolo olusekelwe ku-16 loba umutsho oyimfihlo olenhlamvu ezingu-16 kumbe ngaphezulu). Gcina ikhophi: ngaphandle kwale ifayela isipele asisoze sibuyiselwe.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Ifayela yesizindalwazi se-SQLite (yakhiwa eceleni kwesipele, ayibhalwa phezu kwefayela esetshenziswayo loba sekutheni)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebenzisa isizindalwazi se-SQLite esakhiwe kutsha ekuqaliseni kutsha okulandelayo (isizindalwazi esidala esithathelwe indawo sizagcinwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isizukulwane esikhethiweyo esikhathini esikhethiweyo? Isipele esiqhubekayo siyama okwesikhatshana ngesikhathi sokubuyisela.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isipele esikhethiweyo? Okunamathiselweyo/izithombe zabasebenzisi kubhalwa kusistimu yamafayela njalo idatha kusizindalwazi ngokwemodi ekhethiweyo.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ngokuzikhethela: umzila wefayela lokhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi kuseva.
gcs-credentials-description: Ngokuzikhethela: namathisela ukhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi. Tshiya kungelalutho ukuze usebenzise ifayela lokhiye loba imininingwane ezenzakalelayo.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yesevisi ye-WeKan ukufinyelela kokufunda/ukubhala ebhakedeni: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ibhakede lakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", namathisela i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yesevisi — inani le-"client_email" elivela kukhiye wakho we-JSON — ubusukhetha indima ethi "Storage Object Admin" njalo Londoloza.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tshiya kungelalutho ukuze ugcine inani lamanje.
gcs-bucket-description: Ibizo lebhakede le-Cloud Storage lokugcina amafayela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tshiya kungelalutho (kusebenzisa isiphetho sesifunda). Okusebenzisana le-S3: i-Endpoint URL evela ku-console yakho ye-MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ibhakede lakho → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ibizo lebhakede lakho (loba Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → umsebenzisi wakho → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetha ukusetshenziswa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Kuboniswa njenge-'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Isikrini esifanayo lese-Access key ID; i-'Secret access key' iboniswa kanye kuphela nxa ukhiye udalwe — kopisha ngaleso sikhathi (loba Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → ibizo eliboniswa phezulu (njalo ngaphansi kwe-Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → isiqukathi sakho (loba + Container ukuze udale esinye).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → isikhethi sephrojekthi phezulu → i-ID yephrojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ibizo lebhakede lakho (loba Create ukuze udale elinye).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Umzila kuseva ye-WeKan oya kufayela lokhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi elilandiweyo (elidalwe ngezansi). Sebenzisa LOKHU LOBA unamathisele i-JSON enkambini engezansi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yesevisi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kulanda ifayela). Namathisela okumunyethweyo lapha, loba ulondoloze ifayela ubusumisa umzila walo ngenhla.
migration-stop-confirm: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukumisa konke ukuthutha?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ukuze okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kubonakale, kuhambise kusuka ku-CollectionFS kuya kuloba yiphi enye indawo yokugcina.
s3-enabled-description: Sebenzisa i-AWS S3 loba i-MinIO ukugcina amafayela
s3-endpoint-description: I-URL yesiphetho se-S3 (isib., s3.amazonaws.com loba minio.example.com)
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kwenza ukuhlola lokulungisa okupheleleyo kobuqotho bedatha yebhodi, kuhlanganise lokuhlelwa kwezinhlu, izindawo zamakhadi lesakhiwo semizila.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Kususa ngokuphepha izinhlu ezingelalutho eziphindwe kabili. Kususa kuphela izinhlu ezingelamakhadi FUTHI ezilolunye uluhlu olulesihloko esifanayo olumumethe amakhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Kuthola njalo kubuyisele amakhadi lezinhlu ezingela-swimlaneId loba listId. Kudala umzila othi 'Amakhadi alahlekileyo' ukuze zonke izinto ezilahlekileyo zibonakale futhi.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Kubuyisela yonke imizila, izinhlu lamakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando. Kulungisa ngokuzenzakalela loba yiphi i-swimlaneId loba listId engekho ukuze izinto zibonakale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Kuthola njalo kulungise izinhlu ezingekho loba ezonakeleyo esakhiweni sebhodi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Kubuyekeza ama-URL ezithombe zabasebenzisi zamalunga ebhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo njalo kulungise izikhombo zezithombe eziphukileyo.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kubuyekeza wonke ama-URL amafayela okunamathiselweyo kuleli bhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo njalo kulungise izikhombo zamafayela eziphukileyo.
migrations-description: Sebenzisa ukuhlola lokulungisa ubuqotho bedatha yaleli bhodi. Ukuthutha ngakunye kungasetshenziswa ngokwehlukana.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzakwenza ukuthutha okupheleleyo ukuze kuhlole njalo kulungise ubuqotho bedatha yebhodi. Lokhu kungathatha isikhatshana. Qhubeka?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Lokhu kuzaqala kuguqule loba yiziphi izinhlu ezabelwanwayo zibe yizinhlu zomzila ngamunye, bese kususa izinhlu ezingelalutho eziloluhlu oluphindwe kabili olulesihloko esifanayo olumumethe amakhadi. Kuzasuswa kuphela izinhlu ezingelalutho ezingadingekiyo ngempela. Qhubeka?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzakudala umzila othi 'Amakhadi alahlekileyo' njalo kubuyisele wonke amakhadi lezinhlu ezingela-swimlaneId loba listId. Lokhu kuthinta kuphela izinto ezingekho eNgobweni yomlando. Qhubeka?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Lokhu kuzabuyisela YONKE imizila, izinhlu lamakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando, kubenze babonakale futhi. Zonke izinto ezilama-ID angekho zizalungiswa ngokuzenzakalela. Lokhu akubuyiseki lula. Qhubeka?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzathola njalo kulungise izinhlu ezingekho loba ezonakeleyo esakhiweni sebhodi. Qhubeka?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzabuyekeza ama-URL ezithombe zabasebenzisi zamalunga ebhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo. Qhubeka?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzabuyekeza wonke ama-URL amafayela okunamathiselweyo kuleli bhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo. Qhubeka?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Akulamizila, izinhlu loba amakhadi alahlekileyo angabuyiselwa
migration-progress-note: Sicela ulinde ngesikhathi sithuthela ibhodi lakho esakhiweni sakamuva...
conversion-info-text: Lokhu kuguqulwa kwenziwa kanye ebhodini ngalinye njalo kuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ungaqhubeka usebenzisa ibhodi ngendlela ejwayelekileyo.
converting-board-description: Kuguqulwa isakhiwo sebhodi ukuze sisebenze ngcono. Lokhu kungathatha isikhatshana.
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Misa okwesikhatshana ukuthutha nxa ukusetshenziswa kwe-CPU kudlula leli phesenti (10-90)
migration-info-text: Ukuthutha izizindalwazi kwenziwa kanye njalo kuthuthukisa ukusebenza kohlelo. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngemuva lanxa uvala isiphequluli sakho.
migration-warning-text: Sicela ungavali isiphequluli sakho ngesikhathi sokuthutha. Umsebenzi uzaqhubeka ngemuva kodwa ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuqeda.
account-locked: I-akhawunti ivalelwe okwesikhatshana ngenxa yemizamo yokungena eminengi eyehlulekileyo. Sicela uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
username-too-short: Ibizo lomsebenzisi kumele libe lezinhlamvu okungenani ezingu-3
problems-summary-help: Hlola izindawo zezinkinga osuzibukezile, ubusuchofoza u-Vuma ukuze umise kutsha inani lazo lezinkinga ezintsha.
problems-in-progress-help: Lokhu kuthutha loba ukulungisa kuyasebenza khathesi. Ukungena kungahamba kancane, loba kubonise ukuthi "Kumele ungene" loba isiphenduli esithi "Kuyalayishwa, sicela ulinde", kuze kuqedwe njalo i-CPU yehle.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Kulungiswe amakhadi angu-__fixed__. Amakhadi angu-__unfixable__ kawalabhodi njalo awakwazi ukulungiswa ngokuzenzakalela.
import-board-source: Ngenisa ibhodi (ukukhitshwa kwe-Trello, Jira, WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Ibhodi lenziwe, kodwa ezinye izingxenye zefayela azikwazanga ukulethwa. Umbiko ofanayo ugcinwe ku-Iphaneli yomlawuli → Izinkinga → Ukubuyisela.
import-parts-instruction: Izingxenye eziphawuliweyo kuphela ezingeniswayo. Ukukhetha okufanayo kuyasetshenziswa lapho kukhutshwa.
import-wekan-file: Ngenisa kusuka efayeleni lokukhitshwa le-.json loba le-.zip:
import-file-label: Khetha ifayili yokuthumela, loba unamathisele umbhalo wayo ngaphansi:

r-blocks-help: Xhumanisa isiqalisi esisodwa lesenzo esisodwa. Donsa amabhuloki usuka ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Sebenzisa isihleli sefomu ukuthola okukhethwayo okuthuthukileyo.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yomthetho kayitholakali. Sebenzisa isihleli sefomu ukuhlola lo mthetho.
r-blocks-invalid: Xhumanisa isiqalisi esisodwa kuphela lesenzo esisodwa. Susa amabhuloki angaxhumananga loba engeziweyo ungakalondolozi.
r-blocks-conflict: Lo mthetho utshintshile ubusahlela. Layisha kabutsha umthetho olondoloziweyo ungakalondolozi.
r-blocks-permission: Imvumo yomphathi webhodi iyadingeka ukuhlela imithetho.
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikhadi lingaba sekukhutshweni okunengi. Bamba u-Ctrl (u-Cmd kuMac) ukukhetha okungaphezu kokukodwa; kusule konke ukususa ikhadi kukho konke ukukhutshwa.
scrum-backlog-help: Hlela umsebenzi ngezinga lemisebenzi elindileyo. Nika amakhadi ku-sprint ehleliweyo loba esebenzayo.
scrum-report-help: Imibiko igcina izilinganiso ezivela ezithombeni ze-sprint. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo zibalwa ngokwehlukileyo; kaziso izilinganiso zikazero. Qathanisa ijubane kuphela phakathi kwezilinganisi zesilinganiso lezinqubomgomo ezifanayo.
scrum-confirm-close: Vala le sprint ulondoloze imiphumela yayo? Amakhadi angaqediwanga azahanjiswa endaweni ekhethiweyo.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela le sprint? Amakhadi ayo azagcina ubulunga bawo aze anikwe kabutsha.
scrum-partial-report: Umbiko oyingxenye: kuphela amakhadi onikwe wona khathesi afakiweyo.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Le sprint iphethe ingxenye kuphela yesithombe sokuqala.
scrum-history-job-running: Kubuyiselwa emuva kumbe kwenziwa futhi inguquko enkulu: __done__ emigqeni yembali engu-__total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Ukubuyisela emuva kumbe ukwenza futhi inguquko enkulu kumile. Cindezela futhi buyisela emuva kumbe yenza futhi ukuze uqhubeke:
scrum-daily-observations: Ububanzi bomsebenzi bansuku zonke lomsebenzi oseleyo (okubonwayo)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Ibha ngayinye itshengisa okubonwe kokuqala okubhaliweyo kwelanga le-UTC, ngesikhathi esitshengisiweyo. Amalanga angekho atshiyiwe. Lokhu okubonwayo kakubhali konke ukutshintsha loba kutshengise izamba zokucina kwelanga. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo kaziso zikazero. Sebenzisa isenzo esithi Thumela salesi sigaba ekuboneni kwansuku zonke; isenzo esithi Thumela sebha yamathuluzi sithumela imiphumela ye-sprint.
scrum-daily-empty: Kakulakubonwa kwansuku zonke okubhalelwe le sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ububanzi bomsebenzi lomsebenzi oseleyo, inguquko ngayinye
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe kutsha ngembali yebhodi kusukela ekuqaleni kwesikhathi somsebenzi: umugqa owodwa wenguquko ngayinye kumakhadi esikhathi somsebenzi, ezilinganisweni kumbe emsebenzini ophelileyo.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Imbali ayibuyiseli umfanekiso wesimo salesi sikhathi somsebenzi uqobo: ezinye inguquko zenziwa zingabhalwanga embalini, ngakho amanani la awaphelelanga.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kwenelisiwe ukufunda inguquko zokuqala kuphela; ukwakha kutsha akuphelelanga.
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Okubonwe kokuqala okubhaliweyo kwelanga ngalinye le-UTC; amalanga angekho atshiyiwe. Okubonwayo kakubhali konke ukutshintsha loba izamba zokucina kwelanga. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo kaziso zikazero.
scrum-import-pending: Ukungenisa kwe-Scrum kakuqediwanga. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum lokuthumela imibiko kakutholakali.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Ukungenisa okuphazanyiswe yikuqalisa kutsha kungaqediswa lapha ngemva kokuma. Nxa icebo lokungenisa lingagcinwanga liphelele, kungakhanselwa kuphela; lokhu akuntshintshi lutho ebhodini.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetha ukuthumela kwebhodi likaWeKan loba ifayili yokudlulisela ye-Scrum. Ama-sprint lokukhutshwa le bhodi esela kona kuyaxhumaniswa, kakuphindwa. Amakhadi afaniswa nge-ID, loba ngenombolo yekhadi lesihloko; amakhadi angafanani ayabhalwa njalo atshiywe enjalo. Bona kuqala ukuze ubone okuzatshintsha.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ama-sprint: __created__ amatsha, __matched__ asevele ekule bhodi, __skipped__ kawangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ukukhutshwa: __created__ okutsha, __matched__ sekuvele kukule bhodi, __skipped__ kakungeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Kakulalutho okumele kutshintshwe: le bhodi isilokhu kuhlela.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kungenisiwe njalo kwabhalwa eMlandweni.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikhadi lifana lamakhadi angaphezu kwelilodwa kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikhadi lingelelinye ibhodi njalo latshiywa linjalo: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint loba ukukhutshwa kufana lokungaphezu kokukodwa kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, ukukhutshwa loba umcimbi kakukwazanga ukungeniswa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Khetha inani lokungqubuzana ngakunye. Ukuvumelanisa kuyazama futhi ngemva kokukhetha ngakunye. Kakulalutho oluthunyelwa kusistimu yomthombo.
sync-conflict-refresh: Qalisa ukuvumelanisa futhi ukuze uhlole amanani akhathesi.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakhadi onikwe wona ahloliwe. Kakuselakungqubuzana kwezikhala. Ukuvumelanisa kohlu lonke kakuqaliswanga.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Susa ukuhlanganisa kokuvumelanisa kwalokhu okuphindiweyo kuphela. Okuphakathi kwakho kuhlala kuWeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Ukufaka eNgobweni yomlando kuvinjwe ngamakhadi amancane asebenzayo
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Into yomthombo kayisekho, kodwa amakhadi amancane asebenzayo avimbela ukufakwa eNgobweni yomlando. Gcina leli khadi endaweni ngokususa ukuhlanganisa kwalo kokuvumelanisa. Amakhadi amancane kawatshintshwa.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gcina ikhadi langaphambili lingatshintshwanga udale ikhadi elitsha lokuvumelanisa kulolu luhlu. Ukuzama futhi kusebenzisa kabutsha elithatha indawo.
sync-preview-saved: Kusekelwe ezilungiselelweni ezilondoloziweyo. Ukuvumelanisa khathesi kulanda kuhlole umthombo futhi.
sync-preview-unavailable: Londoloza umthombo wokuvumelanisa ungakaceli ukubona kuqala.
sync-preview-blocked: Xazulula ukungqubuzana okungaphansi ungakahloli uhlelo lwezinguquko.
sync-preview-scope: Amanani akhuluma ngezikhala zomthombo ezilungisiweyo. Idatha eyengeziweyo ingatshiywa ngumhlaziyi womthombo.
sync-source-scope: Izindlela ziqoqanisa ukuvela kwezikhala ezintweni zomthombo. Izinto ezingahlanganiswanga zibikwa zizonke; amanani azo kawatshengiswa.
sync-source-truncated: Umbiko unqunyelwe ezindleleni ezingu-100 lamabizo ezikhala afinyeziweyo.
sync-report-retention: Ukuqaliswa okungu-20 kwakamuva. Imibiko igcinwa okwamalanga angu-30.
sync-report-partial: Ukuqaliswa okwehlulekileyo loba okungaqediwanga kungabe kutshintshe amanye amakhadi. Le mibiko kayiqhubeki loba ibuyisele emuva ukuqaliswa.
sync-report-unavailable: Imibiko yokuqaliswa idinga imvumo yokubhala kohlu lonke leseva etholakalayo.
sync-recovery-description: Imibiko yokuvumelanisa egcinwe kusukela emalangeni angu-30 adlulileyo. Dinga nge-ID yebhodi loba yohlu. Umphumela ongaqediwanga ungabe usaqhubeka loba uphazamisekile. Vuselela ukuze uhlole futhi; le mibiko ingeke iqhubeke loba ibuyisele emuva izinguquko.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Kakukwazeki ukufunda ukuhlola kokuvumelanisa. Hlola imvumo yomlawuli lokutholakala kweseva.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Khetha isikhala sezinombolo esile-ID yesikhala sikaJira lesilinganisi sesilinganiso, njengalokhu sidalwe ngukungenisa kukaJira okuhlanganisiweyo. Izinguquko zendawo zihlolwa njengokungqubuzana. Amanani omthombo angekho kawananzwa; i-null ecacileyo isula inani elihlanganisiweyo.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Isisindo kumbe isilinganiso sesikhathi se-GitLab sibhalwa endaweni yezinombolo oyikhethayo. Inguquko zalapha zihlolwa njengokungavumelani; udaba olungelasisindo lusula inani elixhunyiweyo.
email-recovery-description: Umugqa owodwa kumamukeli ngamunye. Dinga nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Okuqukethwe yimilayezo lezindawo ze-imeyili yomamukeli akuboniswa. Ukumisa okwesikhatshana kubamba imilayezo ekhona lezayo; ukuqhubeka kuzama ukuthumela imilayezo esemzileni khathesi. Ukukhansela kususa imilayezo efakwe emzileni kuze kube yisikhathi sesicelo. Nxa ukuthumela kuqhubeka, zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana. Umlayezo osuqalisile ukuthunyelwa awungeke ubuyiselwe emuva, njalo ukuthumela okungaqinisekanga kungaphindwa. Ukwehluleka okungapheliyo lemilayezo esifinyelele emkhawulweni wokuzama kugcinelwa ukuhlolwa. Ukuzama futhi imilayezo eyehlulekileyo kuqalisa umjikelezo omutsha wokuzama njalo kugcina ukumiswa okwesikhatshana okukhona.
email-recovery-empty: Akulamlayezo osemzileni kumbe abamukeli abamiselwe ukuthumela okwesikhatshana.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwaniseki ukubala umzila wama-imeyili. Hlola imvumo yomlawuli lokutholakala kweseva.
email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela kumbe omunye umsebenzi womzila kuyaqhubeka. Vuselela njalo uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Vuselela umzila njalo uzame umsebenzi ofanayo futhi nxa kudingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi wohlelo sithathe indawo yalesi sicelo. Kuboniswa umumo womzila wakhathesi.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonke imilayezo esemzileni khathesi yalumamukeli? Okuqukethwe yiyo kuzasuswa njalo ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayezo emitsha eyenziwe ngemva kwalesi sicelo izagcinwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ukulethwa kakukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa; hlola ungakazami futhi
sync-time-estimate-hint: Izilinganiso zesikhathi zisebenzisa izikhala zezinombolo zesikhathi sokuqala/esiseleyo ezidalwe ngukungenisa kukaJira. Kumele kube lesikhala esisodwa kuphela esifanayo kule bhodi. Ukuhlela kwendawo kuhlolwa njengokungqubuzana; amanani omthombo angekho kawananzwa njalo i-null ecacileyo isula inani.
sync-planning-hint: I-sprint lokukhutshwa kuvumelaniswa kuphela lapho i-Scrum ivuliwe kule bhodi. I-sprint loba ukukhutshwa okungekho kudalwa kule bhodi, lamalanga anikwa ngumthombo; okukhona kufaniswa nge-ID yakho yomthombo kuqala, ngemva kwalokho ngebizo. Ukutshintsha kokuhlela kwendawo kuhlala kuze umthombo utshintshe ukuhlela kwaleyo ndaba, njalo ukuvumelanisa kokuqala kakuloku kususi ukuhlela.
activity-recovery-description: Izaziso ezingaqediwanga ziyazanywa futhi ngokuzenzakalela. Hlola imisebenzi engekho loba etshintshiweyo ungakazami futhi. Ukuzama futhi kakuloku kudali kabutsha umsebenzi.
activity-recovery-busy: Omunye osebenzayo uphethe lesi saziso. Vuselela uzame futhi.
activity-recovery-denied: Imvumo yowamukelayo loba okuthandwayo kwezaziso kakusavumeli ukulethwa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenzi wokuqala kawukho loba utshintshile. Kakulalutho oludalwe kabutsha.
activity-recovery-failed: Kakukwazekanga ukuqeda ukulethwa kwezaziso. Umsebenzi olindileyo ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Lesi saziso sitshintshile selokhu salayishwa. Hlola isimo esivuselelweyo ungakazami futhi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Kakukwazekanga ukuqinisekisa isilungiselelo sokulethwa. Vuselela uhlole isimo saso sakhathesi.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela unomphela ukulethwa okuseleyo kwalo msebenzi? Lokhu kungeke kuqhutshekwe. Ama-imeyili aselayini lezaziso esezilethiwe kakubuyiswa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Hlola imizamo ebhaliweyo yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho. Imizamo engaqinisekiswanga ingabe isathumela kumbe iphazamisekile. Lo umbiko kawuphindi uthumele njalo kawukhanseli ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Akulamizamo yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho ehambelana lalokhu kudinga.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Kakukwazekanga ukulayisha imizamo ye-imeyili yemithetho. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayiphindi ithumele yona yodwa i-imeyili engaqinisekiswanga. Ukuthumela futhi kuya kuphela kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga. Yimake njengethunyelweyo nxa usazi ukuthi isifikile, kumbe ukhansele ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ukuthumela kokuqala kungabe kusaqhubeka. Unganquma ngemva kuka-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Thumela i-imeyili le futhi kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga? Loba ngubani iseva yakhe yemeyili eyamukele umlayezo ingazisanga i-WeKan uzawuthola kabili.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maka i-imeyili le njengethunyelwe kubo bonke? Yenza lokhu kuphela nxa usazi ukuthi isifikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela ukuthumela i-imeyili le? Ayisoze ithunyelwe kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ukuthumela kokuqala kungabe kusaqhubeka. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ukuthumela futhi okwangaphambili kungabe kusaqhubeka. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonke abamukeli sebeqinisekisiwe. Esikhundleni sokuyithumela futhi, yimake njengethunyelweyo.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iseva yemeyili ayiphendulanga. Umlayezo othunyelwe futhi ungabe usufikile kumbe ungafikanga; utshengiswa njengosaqhubekayo.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Omunye umphathi uxazulula i-imeyili le. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyili egciniweyo ayisahambelani lalumzamo, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Irekhodi eligciniweyo lalumzamo alivumelekanga, ngakho awukwazi ukuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: I-imeyili le ayikwazanga ukuxazululwa. Vuselela ikhasi ubusuzama futhi.
rule-email-legacy-description: Ama-imeyili la emithetho alungiswa yinguqulo yangaphambili ye-WeKan eyayingabhalanga ukuthi okuqukethwe yiwo kuvela ngaphi, ngakho i-WeKan ayisoze iwathumele yona yodwa. Ngemva kokuhlola ukuthi umbhali womthetho uselalo ilungelo lokungena, xhumanisa i-imeyili futhi ukuze ilungiswe ngokwesimo samanje sekhadi, kumbe uyilahle.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lungisa i-imeyili le futhi ngokwesimo samanje sekhadi? Okuqukethwe yiyo kungahluka kulokho okwalungiswa ngaphambili.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla i-imeyili le? Ayisoze ithunyelwe loba nini.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Akukwazanga ukulayishwa ama-imeyili emithetho alindele ukuhlolwa. Vuselela ikhasi ukuze uzame futhi.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Umbhali womthetho akaselalo ilungelo lokungena kulelikhadi, kumbe umthetho usuntshintshile, ngakho i-imeyili ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa futhi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Isenzo esibangele i-imeyili le sintshintshile, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa futhi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikhadi okuvela kulo i-imeyili le alisatholakali, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa futhi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ukusebenza komthetho okulungise i-imeyili le akusagciniwe, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa futhi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: I-imeyili le isivele ithunyelwe, kuzanyiwe ukuyithumela, kumbe ilahliwe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Isenzo lesi asikwazanga ukuqedwa. Vuselela ikhasi ubusuzama futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-description: Ngamunye walemisebenzi yokuvumelanisa uluhlu elondoloziweyo wema phakathi njalo kawusakwazi ukuqedwa, ngoba uluhlu lwawo lususiwe, ladalwa kabutsha loba lalungiswa kabutsha, loba umsebenzisi owawuqalisayo walahlekelwa yimvumo yokubhala. Lapho owodwa usalindile, lolo luhlu alukwazi ukuvumelanisa. Wulahle ukuze uluhlu luvumelanise futhi: izinguquko esezenziwe ziyahlala, izinguquko ezilondoloziweyo eziseleyo kaziloku zibhalwe, njalo ukuvumelanisa okulandelayo kuqathanisa uluhlu lomthombo walo futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Uluhlu lususiwe, ladalwa kabutsha loba izilungiselelo zalo zokuvumelanisa zatshintsha
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Umsebenzisi owawuqalisayo kasaselayo imvumo yokubhala kulo lonke uluhlu
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Kulondolozwe yinguqulo yangaphambili kaWeKan ngaphandle kwalokho okwakuqalisayo
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Ungaphindwa futhi khathesi njalo uzaziqedela, ngakho ungeke ulahlwe.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lahla lo msebenzi wokuvumelanisa uluhlu olondoloziweyo? Izinguquko osuzenzile ziyahlala; ezinye kaziloku zibhalwe. Uluhlu lungabe seluvumelanisa futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Kutshengiswa abangu-50 abadala kuphela. Lahla abanye uvuselele ukuze ubone abanengi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Kakukwazekanga ukulayisha imisebenzi yokuvumelanisa uluhlu. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Lo msebenzi kawutholakalanga ubambekile, ngakho ungeke ulahlwe.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Lo msebenzi ungaphindwa futhi khathesi njalo uzaziqedela, ngakho kawulahlwanga.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Lolu luhlu luyavumelanisa khathesi. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Isenzo lesi asikwazanga ukuqedwa. Vuselela ikhasi ubusuzama futhi.
interrupted-import-description: Ngakunye kwalokhu kungenisa amabhodi kwema phakathi - iseva yaqalisa kabutsha, loba ukungenisa kwehluleka - kwatshiya ibhodi elingaphelelanga. Ukungenisa kungeke kuqhutshekwe, ngoba ifayili yomthombo wakho kayigcinwa. Gcina ibhodi linjalo, loba ulilahle ungenise ifayili futhi. Ukulahla kususa ibhodi elidalwe yilokhu kungenisa lakho konke okukulo, kuhlanganisa lakho konke okwengezwe kulo selokhu.
interrupted-import-scrum: Isigaba sayo se-Scrum silendawo yaso yokuhlola (__state__, __next__ ku-__total__ amagxathu). Nxa ugcina ibhodi, liqede loba ulilahle ekubuyiseleni kokungenisa kwe-Scrum kwebhodi.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ imizila, __lists__ izinhlu, __cards__ amakhadi, __checklists__ izinhlu zokuhlola, __comments__ amazwana, __attachments__ okunamathiselweyo
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gcina leli bhodi elingaphelelanga linjalo? Kakulalutho olususwayo, njalo ukungenisa kakusabhalwa lapha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lahla lokhu kungenisa? Ibhodi elikudalileyo lakho konke okukulo kususwa unomphela.
interrupted-import-truncated: Kutshengiswa abangu-50 abadala kuphela. Gcina loba ulahle abanye uvuselele ukuze ubone abanengi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Kakukwazekanga ukulayisha ukungenisa amabhodi okuphazamisekileyo. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ibhodi ele-id le kalidalwanga yilokhu kungenisa, ngakho kalithintwanga.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Isigaba sayo se-Scrum sisabhalwa loba sibuyiselwa. Zama futhi ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Isenzo lesi asikwazanga ukuqedwa. Vuselela ikhasi ubusuzama futhi.
saml-login-not-started: Ukungena lokhu nge-SAML akuqaliswanga kule ithebhu yesiphequluli. Sicela ungene futhi.
history-request-pending-undo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuhlehlisa kwakho untshintsho lokucina.
history-request-pending-redo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuphinda wenze untshintsho lwakho lokucina.
history-request-hint: Ukuzama futhi kuphinda isicelo esifanayo, ngakho akusoze kuhlehlise untshintsho lwesibili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ukubuyisela emuva, ukuphinda loba ukubuyisela kwezinguquko ze-Scrum kwema ngenxa yokungqubuzana. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kule bhodi kuvinjiwe kuze kuxazululwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ ku-__total__ izinguquko zabhalwa, __pending__ kazibhalwanga, njalo __conflicted__ zatshintshwa ngomunye umuntu selokhu.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ukubuyisela emuva kubuyisela yonke imibhalo etshintshiweyo njengoba yayinjalo ngaphambili; kunikwa kuphela nxa kungekho omunye otshintshe leyo mibhalo selokhu. Ukugcina ibhodi linjalo kususa umsebenzi omileyo njalo kakutshintshi mibhalo. Kunoma yiyiphi indlela, kubhalwa ku-Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gcina yonke imibhalo injalo khathesi, kuhlanganisa lezinguquko umsebenzi omileyo osuzibhalile?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umphathi webhodi angakubuyisela emuva loba agcine ibhodi linjalo.
login-setting-after-restart: Kuqala ukusebenza ngemva kokuthi i-WeKan iqaliswe kutsha
login-setting-env-only: Yindawo yeseva kuphela ebeka lokhu. Kutshengiswa lapha ngokokubala kuphela.
email-to-card-description: I-imeyili ethunyelwe ekhelini lebhodi yakho iba likhadi kuleyo bhodi.
email-to-card-webhook: I-URL ye-webhook engenayo yomhlinzeki weposi (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kumbe isidluliseli se-MIME esingaphucwanga)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Ibhodi lapho ama-imeyili athunyelwa kuleli grain aya khona
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Lutho - ama-imeyili kuphela alethokheni yebhodi esihlokweni
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Faka lokhu esihlokweni ukuze ufike kule bhodi njengawe:
email-to-card-address-private: Lilondoloze liyimfihlo: loba ngubani olalo angangeza amakhadi njengawe.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Umphathi webhodi kakakavuli i-imeyili kule bhodi.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Uwacimile amakheli akho ebhodi kuZilungiselelo zelungu.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: I-grain kayikabi lekheli layo le-imeyili. Layisha kabusha ikhasi.
inbound-account-invalid: Ibhokisi leposi le-IMAP lidinga ibizo lesiphakeli elifaneleyo.
feature-views-email-desc: Ibhodi njengebhokisi leposi: uluhlu lwe-imeyili yiBhokisi lokungenayo, izinhlu ngamafolda, amalebula ngamalebula, njalo amalunga abhala aphendule ama-imeyili esuka ekhelini lebhodi.
email-view-not-receiving: Le bhodi kayikamukeli ama-imeyili. Kuvule kuZilungiselelo zezaziso zebhodi → I-imeyili ibe likhadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Elinye lamakheli kayisilo ikheli le-imeyili elifaneleyo.
email-view-too-many: Kuthunyelwe ama-imeyili amanengi kakhulu ehoreni elidlulileyo. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ibhodi njengendawo yokuxoxa: izindawo zokusebenza, amabhodi, imizila, izinhlu lamakhadi njengesihlahla seziteshi, ikhadi phakathi lemibono yalo njengemilayezo yengxoxo.
chat-view-pick-card: Khetha ikhadi eziteshini ukuze ulibone lapha.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Amakhadi afananayo emaqoqweni amanengi amakholomu alamabizo - ngokuphela, ngokuqakatheka, ngesigaba kumbe ngokunye - asuswa phakathi kwamakholomu ngokuhudula.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Imenyu yebhodi → Imithetho iphakamisa imithetho ngalokho abantu abakwenza ngesandla kaninginingi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Imenyu yebhodi → Isifinyezo sitshengisa lokho okwenziwe ngumuntu ngamunye ebhodini ngosuku kumbe ngeviki lokucina, lalokho okwedlulelwe yisikhathi.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Imenyu yebhodi → Kusukela ekuvakatsheleni kwakho kokucina kutshengisa lokho abanye abakuntshintshileyo ebhodini.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ukudinga okuphelele kuyazwisisa imitsho efana lo "amakhadi ami adlulelwe yisikhathi".
column-sets-empty: Akulamaqoqo amakholomu okwamanje. Umphathi webhodi angenza elilodwa: liphe ibizo, ubusungezelela amakholomu alo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Ibhodi njengomlandeli wezindaba we-GitHub kumbe we-Gitea: amakhadi njengezindaba, amalebula lezinqophiso, imibono njengengxoxo, okunamathiselweyo njengamafayili, lomlando webhodi lokubuyisela.
vcs-no-milestones: Akukabi lezinqophiso. Ilebula elelanga lokucina liyisinqophiso.
vcs-no-list: Ibhodi le kalalo uhlu kumbe umzila wodaba.
card-qr-code-desc: Yihlole ukuze uvule ikhadi leli efonini kumbe kuthebhulethi.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ixhumanisi lekhadi leli lide kakhulu ukuba yikhodi ye-QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Akukabi le-wiki. Ukungeniswa kwenhlangano ye-GitHub kuletha i-wiki yendawo yokugcina lapha.
github-org-import-desc: Yonke indawo yokugcina yenhlangano kumbe yomsebenzisi iba libhodi layo, elivulwa ku-Board View / Version Control: izindaba zayo lemibono yazo, amalebula lamafayela, okukhutshiweyo kwayo, imisebenzi ye-GitHub Actions njengeMithetho, le-wiki yayo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Kuyadingeka ezindaweni zokugcina eziyimfihlo lomkhawulo we-API ophezulu. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngesikhathi ukungenisa kuqhubeka njalo akulondolozwa.
github-org-import-result: Izindaba ezingu-%s, okukhutshiweyo okungu-%s, imithetho engu-%s, amakhasi e-wiki angu-%s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Bhala ibizo lenhlangano kumbe lomsebenzisi, kumbe ikheli layo le-GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: Ama-API e-REST asesimeni sama-API ezinye izilandeleli, ukuze izinhlelo lama-script azo zisebenzise le WeKan njengengemuva lazo: lokho ezikulondolozayo kugcinwa ku-WeKan, emabhodini e-WeKan. Ngayinye ivaliwe kuze kube yilapho ikhethwa lapha. Kakho elelamalungelo alo: iklayenti lingena nge-token ye-API ye-WeKan njalo lingabona lintshintshe kuphela lokho umuntu lowo angakubona akuntshintshe ku-WeKan. Wonke adinga ukuthi i-WeKan REST API ivulwe (WITH_API=true). Ikheli elingaphansi kwengayinye yilo iklayenti elilisebenzisa njengeseva yalo.
optional-api-trello-desc: Izinhlelo lama-script abhalelwe i-REST API ye-Trello (ngokwesibonelo Trellinator) zisebenza le-WeKan: amabhodi, uluhlu, amakhadi, amalebula, amalunga, imibono lezinhlu zokuhlola. I-token ye-Trello yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan. Ukususa ikhadi kuliyisa esiphaleni ku-WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Amaklayenti e-REST API v2 ye-Jira asebenza le-WeKan: iprojekthi libhodi (isikhiye sayo yisikhiye sebhodi), indaba likhadi (DEV-7), isimo luluhlu, njalo inguquko ihambisa ikhadi. Ukudinga kwamukela i-JQL elula: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text le-ORDER BY. Ngena nge-token ye-API ye-WeKan njengephasiwedi. Ukususa indaba kuyiyisa esiphaleni.
optional-api-github-desc: Amaklayenti e-REST API ye-GitHub yezindaba asebenza le-WeKan: indawo yokugcina ikhodi libhodi, indaba likhadi, lamalebula, izinqophiso (amalebula alosuku lokuphela), imibono, kanye lokuvuliwe kumbe kuvaliwe njengaku-Ukubukwa kwebhodi / Ukulawula izinguqulo. I-token yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Amaklayenti e-REST API ye-Gitea le-Forgejo yezindaba asebenza le-WeKan ngendlela efanayo le-API ehambelana le-GitHub: indawo yokugcina ikhodi libhodi njalo indaba likhadi. I-token yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan.
bots-none: Akukabi lamabhoti. Ibhoti yisiqhubi kuseva yakho - umsebenzeli we-AI, umsebenzi we-CI, iskripthi - lelibhodi elinikela kuyo amakhadi.
bot-option-not-found: Leyompendulo kayisiyo enye yalezo ezinikelwe yibhoti.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Ama-webhook aphumayo kawavunyelwa ukufinyelela amakheli asenethiwekhini kaWeKan uqobo, ukuze kungabi lomuntu ongakhombisa i-webhook yebhodi kunkonzo yangaphakathi. Bhala lapha ama-host akuleyo nethiwekhi ama-webhook avunyelwe ukuwafinyelela - i-Node-RED, iseva yokuxoxa - linye emugqeni ngamunye, njengebizo loba ikheli, lephothi ukuze kuvunyelwe leyo phothi kuphela. Akulalutho: kalikho. Ngabaphathi besayithi kuphela abangaguqula uluhlu lolu.
account-webhook-desc: Ikheli elilodwa i-WeKan elitshela nxa umuntu engena loba kusenziwa i-akhawunti entsha. Kakulalutho oluthunyelwayo kuze kumakwe isenzakalo esingaphansi. Liphatha isenzakalo, ibizo lomsebenzisi lesikhathi; maka ezinye izikhala kuphela nxa umamukeli ezidinga.
account-webhook-field-ip: Ikheli le-IP lapho ukungena okuvela khona
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela zonke izaziso ezisalindile zemisebenzi emidala kulamalanga amangaki?
vcs-synced-from: Kuvumelaniswe kusuka ku-%s: kuvule njalo ukuvale khona.
vcs-synced-issue: Udaba lolu luvumelanisiwe: luvule njalo uluvale kusilandeleli salo.
sync-write-back: Bhala izinguquko ubuyisele ku-GitLab: isihloko, incazelo, imibono, ukuvala lokuvula futhi
email-bounces-description: Lokho okwenziwa nguWeKan nge-imeyili ebuyayo: ikheli elibhalwe kubi, ibhokisi le-imeyili eligcweleyo, impendulo yokungabi khona, isikhalazo se-spam. Uhlobo ngalunye lulezenzo zalo, ezenziwa nxa selubuyile izikhathi ezingako.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Ikheli kalikho: iphutha lokubhala, i-akhawunti esusiweyo, isizinda esingaziwayo.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Kakuthunyelwanga okwakhathesi: ibhokisi ligcwele, iseva imatasa. Ezinengi ezilandelanayo kuphela ezitsho okuthile.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Izimpendulo zokungabi sehhovisi, zeholide kumbe zesistimu yamathikithi. I-imeyili yafika.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ku-Amazon SES, thumela izaziso zeBounce leComplaint, lomthetho wokwamukela wekheli uWeKan athumela ngalo, esihlokweni se-SNS, ubhalise lelikheli kuso nge-HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ama-ARN ezihloko ze-SNS okufanele amukelwe, elilodwa emugqeni
email-bounces-stopped-only: Amakheli kuphela uWeKan angasathumeli kuwo i-imeyili
email-bounces-clear-hint: Khohlwa ukubuya kwaleli kheli ulithumelele i-imeyili futhi
email-bounces-providers-description: Nxa uWeKan ethumela ngenye yalezi inkonzo, yivule, unike inkonzo leli kheli le-webhook lezehlakalo zayo ze-imeyili ebuyayo lezikhalazo ze-spam, ubusunamathisela lapha ikhiye eyisebenzisayo ukuzisayina, kumbe iphasiwedi oyifake ekhelini njenge-https://user:password@… loba ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Inkonzo evuliweyo idinga ikhiye yayo yokusayina kumbe iphasiwedi.
activity-pub-enabled: Amabhodi omphakathi ashicilela imisebenzi yamakhadi awo ku-fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Nxa kuvuliwe, ibhodi ngalinye lomphakathi lingalandelwa kusuka ku-Mastodon lakwamanye amaseva e-fediverse njengo @board-<id> ekhelini lale WeKan, lemisebenzi emitsha yamakhadi ifinyelela kubalandeli balo. Ngokokubala kuphela: kakukho okuthunyelwa yiseva ye-fediverse okuguqula ibhodi, njalo amabhodi angasese kawashicilelwa loba nini.
caldav-sync-desc: Faka izinsuku zokucina zamakhadi alelibhodi ekhalendeni - Nextcloud Calendar loba ikhalenda yeCalDAV loba yiphi. Ilanga lokucina eliguqulwe ekhalendeni libuyela ekhadini. Sebenzisa iphasiwedi yohlelo, hatshi eyakho.
caldav-invalid-url: Ikheli lekhalenda kumele libe likheli le-http:// loba le-https://, kungelabizo lomsebenzisi loba iphasiwedi phakathi kwalo.
caldav-not-linked: Qala ngokulondoloza ikheli lekhalenda njalo uvule ukuvumelanisa.
webdav-storage-description: Londoloza okunamathiselweyo efolda kuseva ye-WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud loba enye nje. Sebenzisa iphasiwedi yohlelo eyenzelwe iWeKan. Iseva esenethiwekhi yeWeKan uqobo ingasetshenziswa lapha, ngoba ngumlawuli wesayithi kuphela obeka leli kheli.
sqrl-desc: Kuvaliwe ngokwemvelo. Uma kuvuliwe, ikhasi lokungena linika iSQRL, njalo amalunga aqala ngokwengeza ubuqotho bawo beSQRL ku-Izilungiselelo zelunga. ISQRL idinga ukuthi iWeKan ibe kukheli le-https://.
sqrl-scan: Skena ikhowudi nge-app yakho yeSQRL, kumbe uvule uhlelo lwakho lweSQRL kulesi sisetshenziswa.
sqrl-expired: Le khowudi yeSQRL isiphelelwe yisikhathi. Qala kutsha.
sqrl-needs-https: ISQRL idinga ukuthi iWeKan ibe kukheli le-https://.
sqrl-description: Ngena ngobuqotho bakho beSQRL esikhundleni sephasiwedi. Bungeze lapha kanye ngohlelo lwakho lweSQRL; ungabususa lapha nini lanini.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Ukungena ngeSQRL kuvaliwe kule akhawunti kusukela ohlelweni lwakho lweSQRL. Kuvule njalo khonale ngekhowudi yakho yokuhlenga.
sqrl-only-on: Uhlelo lwakho lweSQRL luyikhiye le akhawunti yaba ngeyeSQRL kuphela: zonke ezinye izindlela zokungena ziyaliwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Uhlelo lwakho lweSQRL luyikhiye ngokuqinileyo le akhawunti: ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi lokuntshintsha i-imeyili kuyaliwa.
sqrl-hardlock: Le akhawunti ikhiyelwe kuSQRL: ayingeke ibuyiswe kumbe intshintshwe ngenye indlela.
windows-sso-failed: Ukungena nge-Windows kwehlulekile. I-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows kungenzeka ingavunyelwa lapha.
